description.en: Specifies whether to clear the whitelist.

description.zh: 白名单分组名称，不填默认为”user“。
description.en: The name of the whitelist group. If you leave this parameter empty, the default value user is used.
The ID of the instance. Call the [GetLindormInstanceList](~~426069~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
需要设置的白名单IP地址。

> 127.0.0.1表示禁止所有地址访问，例如192.168.0.0/24表示允许所有192.168.0.X的IP地址访问该Lindorm实例。多个白名单用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The IP addresses to add to the whitelist.

> Set this parameter to 127.0.0.1 to deny access from all IP addresses. For example, 192.168.0.0/24 allows all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.0/24 CIDR block to access the Lindorm instance. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with a comma (,).

title.zh: 设置Lindorm实例的访问白名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hitsdb update-instance-ip-white-list --instance-id ld-bp1z3506imz2f0000 --security-ip-list 192.168.0.X/24 --group-name test_group --delete false --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hitsdb UpdateInstanceIpWhiteList --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test_group --Delete false --InstanceId 'ld-bp1z3506imz2f0000' --SecurityIpList '192.168.0.X/24'
